info.title: docx2adoc — convert a Word document to AsciiDoc
info.description: Word (.docx) to AsciiDoc converter built on AdocNet.Importers.Docx.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file. Defaults to stdout (no media is written).

options.name: --media-dir
options.description: Media directory name beside the output (default: media).

options.name: --report
options.description: Print the fidelity report to stderr.

options.name: --min-fidelity
options.description: Exit with code 3 when fidelity is below n (0-100).

options.name: --reject-revisions
options.description: Keep the original text of tracked changes, not the revised one.

options.name: --comments
options.description: Import Word comments as paragraphs with the comment role.

options.name: --no-admonitions
options.description: Do not detect NOTE:/TIP:/WARNING: paragraphs and callout boxes.

options.name: --no-code-blocks
options.description: Do not detect monospaced paragraphs as listing blocks.

options.name: --no-properties
options.description: Do not import core properties into the document header.

options.name: --plain-formatting
options.description: Drop underline/strikethrough/caps instead of keeping them as roles.

options.name: --keep-heading
options.description: Do not promote a leading top-level heading to the document title.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the progress line on stderr.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 conversion error, 2 usage error, 3 fidelity below --min-fidelity.
